Nobs Approach wiring

3 ON-OFF-ON levers (flaps, gear, parking brake) · status LED. Pins match arduino-esp-32-wiring.md and the firmware. A printable copy of the drawing is in wiring-diagram.svg.

Build notes

  • Pins and placement follow arduino-esp-32-wiring.md and wiring-diagram.pdf: gear and flaps on the analog header, parking brake and LED on the digital header.
  • Lever pin 2 (center) goes to GND; pins 1 and 3 go to the signal pins.
  • You solder from the back, where left and right are swapped.
  • No pull-up resistors needed. Every switch closes to GND and the firmware uses INPUT_PULLUP (pressed reads LOW).
  • Ground: chain every GND lug with one wire per side and land it on a GND pin. All GND tags are the same net.
  • 3.3 V logic only. Never put 5 V on a GPIO pin.
